name: docsmirror-vscode
description: Renders the documentation a @docs pointer targets, in the comment space, powered by the DocsMirror language server.

docsmirror.docsRoot.markdownDescription: Folder that `@docs` paths are relative to, itself relative to the workspace folder. Overrides `docsRoot` in `docsmirror.config.json`.

docsmirror.staleness.agingAfterDays.description: Days after which a target document is reported as aging.

docsmirror.staleness.staleAfterDays.description: Days after which a target document is reported as stale.

docsmirror.inlineDocs.enabled.markdownDescription:
Render a pointer's section as the **documentation itself, inside the comment**, instead of expanding into a peek view. **Click the marker** to open the section where it stands, click it again to close it; `Alt+D` does the same from the keyboard. Every section in the open document is fetched ahead of the reader, so opening one is instant. 

This needs a VS Code API that is still *proposed*, so it must be granted at startup: run **Preferences: Configure Runtime Arguments** and add `"enable-proposed-api": ["docsmirror.docsmirror-vscode"]`, then restart VS Code. Without that step this setting does nothing and expanding falls back to the peek view.

docsmirror.markers.enabled.markdownDescription: Collapse a resolved `@docs` pointer so the line reads as the section title rather than as a path. The file is never modified, and the raw pointer reappears on the line the cursor is on. Turn this off to get a plain inlay hint beside the untouched pointer instead. Requires `#docsmirror.inlayHints.enabled#`.

docsmirror.inlayHints.enabled.markdownDescription: Master switch for annotating pointer lines at all. With `#docsmirror.markers.enabled#` on, the annotation is the collapsed marker; with it off, a plain inlay hint beside the untouched pointer carrying the section title, last-modified date and staleness. Off means the line is left alone entirely.

docsmirror.diagnostics.enabled.description: Report a pointer whose document or anchor does not exist as a problem.

docsmirror.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between the editor and the DocsMirror language server.

scripts.package: npm run build && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --out docsmirror-vscode.vsix
